interface.longDescription: Turn a photo, a topic idea, or an accepted draft into a scroll-stopping REDnote (Xiaohongshu) cover and post image. This AI cover generator creates vertical 3:4 Xiaohongshu note covers with clean backgrounds, bold focal composition, and text-safe areas for beauty, food, fashion, travel, and knowledge content. Generate high-click Xiaohongshu note covers, OOTD post images, food photography covers, product recommendation visuals, and lifestyle note illustrations from one photo or a topic description. Start from a real photo, compose from multiple references, or refine an accepted cover toward a publish-ready result. Optionally it reads Xiaohongshu itself — the notes already running for the topic, one page of a note's top comments, and an account's own recent notes — so Xiaohongshu research, competitor note analysis and comment analysis rest on the platform instead of on guesswork.
